end.summary:
Identified standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines using examples and pictures.
Recognised standing lines as up-and-down and sleeping lines as flat.
Distinguished slanting lines from curved lines when there was no bend.
Answered 5 of 6 attempts unaided; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Om practised identifying standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines. They used body positions and familiar objects to explain the line directions, and later clarified that a slanting line can be tilted without bending. At first, “sleeping” and “straight” seemed confusing, but this was corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Om to find and name one example of each line type in the room.
